bot.name: BananaBrain
bot.description: AIIDE 2025 Protoss bot with varied openings and persistent opponent results. Experimental local practice; human difficulty uncalibrated.

formats.notes: Protoss local practice tested on Fighting Spirit 1.4.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Original pretraining preserved; validated opponent results and mining data persist, preferring saved output over stale read inputs. Reset requires an idle profile and clearing read/write while preserving AI assets.

license.name: BananaBrain License
license.notes: Includes a written-author-permission condition for public StarCraft tournaments. Separate original BWEM notice and LGPLv3 BWAPI notice included.

localDistribution.evidence: docs/releases/bananabrain-sb-5.md: exact-source/storage and notice review, fresh guarded sb.4 review package, offline rebuild, natural x64 Protoss match, isolated concurrent play and crash/save-failure recovery. Scoped supervised local practice only.

publicCompetition.evidence: Written author permission required for public StarCraft tournament entry; not recorded.

limitations: Assigned Protoss, experimental local 1v1 on Fighting Spirit 1.4; random/Terran/Zerg assignments, teams/FFA and x86 StarCraft are unverified.
Requires reviewed ShieldBattery native bridge, accurate gathered resources (#1831), supervised release practice (#1838) and separate writable profiles.
Natural result used a passive Terran control; two command rejection reasons were not captured. Human difficulty uncalibrated.
Shared-profile writers, physical disk exhaustion and exhaustive OS tracing are outside reviewed scope.

sourceReview.evidence: docs/releases/bananabrain-sb-5.md: reviewed pinned bot/dependency/host inputs and actual packaged source; bounded storage, injected save failures, interruption recovery, isolated concurrency and fresh exact-runtime gameplay. Not an OS sandbox or public-competition approval.
